summary: The candidate is a partial functional fix. Its rebuilt native kernel fixes the reported N=16 failure and handles arbitrary tested sizes through 512, but it adds an N<=512 cap without a matching production invariant. The unchanged OffloaderV2/DeepEP caller still unconditionally invokes this operator, so a 513-element local-expert vector remains a concrete counterexample to the issue's arbitrary-valid-count contract.

tests.what_was_measured: At exact base 358c163, rebuilt and loaded the checked-out native source. Exact copies passed for N=32,64,72; N=16 and independent N=17 both raised unexpected N. See base-native-probe.log.

At exact candidate 3ac707e, separately rebuilt and loaded the changed native source. Exact copies passed for N=1,15,16,17,31,32,33,64,72,127,255,256,511,512. N=513 and 1024 were rejected by the new cap; invalid dtype, rank, contiguity, and output size were rejected. See candidate-native-probe.log.

gpu_execution_evidence: Both freshly built native extensions executed on the assigned AMD Instinct MI355X, gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-, and GPU results were compared exactly against independently constructed CPU int32 vectors with rtol=0 and atol=0.
native_rebuild_evidence: Each revision was HIP-translated with zero unsupported CUDA calls and compiled separately by /opt/rocm-7.2.4/bin/hipcc with --offload-arch=gfx950; the resulting extension was loaded directly rather than using the installed wheel.
remaining_counterexamples: A positive 513-element int32 local-expert count vector reaches the unchanged unconditional OffloaderV2/DeepEP call and is rejected with: copy_to_gpu_no_ce supports at most 512 elements, but got 513.
Any larger otherwise valid local-expert vector, such as N=1024, is rejected for the same reason; no caller-side fallback or source invariant limits this path to 512.
remaining_limitations: The original GLM-5.2 weights and two-node TP16/EP16 DeepEP environment were unavailable, so full serving was not reproduced.
Only one AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950 GPU with ROCm 7.2 was assigned; NVIDIA H800/CUDA compilation and execution remain unverified.
The prepared ROCm sgl_kernel package does not register copy_to_gpu_no_ce, so the review rebuilt the checked-out native source as focused Torch extensions.
The candidate's exact N=16 native behavior is verified, but model semantic accuracy and distributed routing were outside what this fixture can establish.
